title: Very thin. Better a seat covers than throws
text: Very thin. Better a seat covers than throws. Well, there's a reason these are sold as a two pack. Each blanket is thin and just not as soft or cuddly as the normal fleece throws we have. They have survived a trip through the washer and dryer without shrinking. I'm actually using these blankets as seat covers on two armchairs for the dogs rather than as blankets.
